expectations.text: Cites the August 2026 Plexon settlement: 8 unlicensed exports of neural-recording systems (~$179K) to China's Academy of Military Medical Sciences, an Entity-Listed institution
expectations.evidence: "BIS settled with Plexon, Inc.... over eight unlicensed exports (~$179K total value) of neural-recording systems to China's Academy of Military Medical Sciences — an entity that had been on the Entity List since 2021"

expectations.text: Notes the penalty structure: $1.7M suspended for 5 years conditioned on an external compliance audit and no further violations — suspended denial order included
expectations.evidence: States "$1.7M (fully suspended over a 5-year probationary period, waived on completion of an external audit and a clean compliance record)" but omits the suspended denial order

expectations.text: Draws the lesson: research/medical/lab equipment is NOT exempt — Entity List license requirements attach regardless of item sensitivity (even EAR99)
expectations.evidence: "research and medical technology is not inherently exempt from Entity List screening... the violation was the end-user"; "Even EAR99 equipment requires a license if..."

expectations.text: Requires screening all parties against the Consolidated Screening List, and resolving affiliate/alias ambiguity (universities' military-linked institutes)
expectations.evidence: "Run the specific institute's legal name, known aliases, and any parent/affiliate entities through the Consolidated Screening List... Check for shared addresses, shared leadership, or subsidiary relationships"

expectations.text: Explains Entity List mechanics: supplemental license requirements per the entity's entry with presumption/policy of denial, no license exceptions in most cases
expectations.evidence: Does not explain Entity List mechanics — no supplemental license requirement per the entity's entry, no presumption/policy of denial, no unavailability of license exceptions
